paper_title: Intrinsically Stretchable Subthreshold Organic Transistors for Highly Sensitive Low-Power Skin-Like Active-Matrix Temperature Sensors
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Adv Funct Materials - 2023 - Kim - Intrinsically Stretchable Subthreshold Organic Transistors for Highly Sensitive/auto/Adv Funct Materials - 2023 - Kim - Intrinsically Stretchable Subthreshold Organic Transistors for Highly Sensitive.md

knowledge_points.content: The semiconducting layer utilizes a blend of DPPT-TT [poly-[2,5] bis(2-octyldodecyl)-3,6-di(thiophen-2-yl) pyrrolo [3,4-c]pyrrole1,4(2H,5H)-dionel-alt-thieno [3,2-b]thiophene] and SEBS (styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene) elastomer to form nanoconfined nanofibers.
knowledge_points.evidence: Figure 1a shows a schematic diagram of an intrinsically stretchable subthreshold OTFT based on nanoconfined [poly-[2,5] bis(2-octyldodecyl)-3,6-di(thiophen-2-yl) pyrrolo [3,4-c]pyrrole1,4(2H,5H)-dionel-alt-thieno [3,2-b]thiophene](DPPT-TT) nanofibers in styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene (SEBs) elastomer.

knowledge_points.content: The stretchable subthreshold organic transistor exhibits a high temperature sensitivity of 9.4% °C⁻¹.
knowledge_points.evidence: The highly temperature-dependent hopping transport of the fully stretchable subthreshold transistor exhibits high-temperature sensitivity (9.4% °C⁻¹)

knowledge_points.content: The device operates at ultralow power consumption levels of less than 1 nW, with a maximum recorded value of 670 pW at -1 V operating voltage.
knowledge_points.evidence: Our OTFT showed a steep subthreshold slope at low voltage... leading to... ultralow power consumption [ < 1 nW: maximum 670 pW

knowledge_points.content: Operating in the subthreshold regime enables higher temperature sensitivity compared to the saturation regime (7.5 times higher) because charge transport is dominated by diffusion, which has a higher thermal activation energy than drift-dominated transport.
knowledge_points.evidence: Moreover, the response in the subthreshold regime is 7.5 times higher than that in the saturation regime (1.2% °C⁻¹... reflecting higher activation energy for carrier diffusion in the subthreshold regime compared to that for carrier drift in the saturation regime.

knowledge_points.content: A homojunction interface between the SEBS-based semiconductor and the SEBS dielectric layer minimizes interface charge traps and thermal expansion coefficient mismatch compared to heterojunctions.
knowledge_points.evidence: The homojunction between the semiconductor and the dielectric films could efficiently minimize the interface charge trap and thermal expansion coefficient mismatch for better interface compatibility than heterojunction.

knowledge_points.content: The stretchable sensor module is fabricated using a transfer printing method for the semiconductor/dielectric layers and thermal evaporation for Ag source, drain, and gate electrodes.
knowledge_points.evidence: the active-matrix transistor array was fabricated on a SEBS substrate using a transfer printing method with thermally evaporated Ag metallization for stretchable source, drain, and gate electrodes.

knowledge_points.content: The OTFT maintains sensing stability and consistent temperature response up to 100% strain in both parallel and perpendicular directions relative to the channel.
knowledge_points.evidence: The initial NS-current value and temperature response remained stable with a small Vth (< 1 V) up to 100% strain in both directions

knowledge_points.content: The sensor achieves a fast response time of 300 ms and a temperature sensing resolution of 0.5 °C.
knowledge_points.evidence: indicating a response time of 300 ms... the typical temperature-sensing resolution of our OTFTs was estimated to be 0.5 °C

knowledge_points.content: The charge trap density (Nt) of the device was calculated to be 1.5 × 10¹¹ cm⁻² eV⁻¹, derived from a measured subthreshold swing (SS) of 0.8 V dec⁻¹.
knowledge_points.evidence: The charge trap density (Nt, 1.5 × 10¹¹ cm⁻² eV), calculated as a function of SS (0.8 V dec⁻¹), remained almost unchanged

knowledge_points.content: The 5x5 active-matrix array enables 2D temperature mapping with a converted temperature accuracy of 94.9% at 25 °C under various deformations including bending, compressing, and twisting.
knowledge_points.evidence: Each subthreshold current of the sensor module was converted into a temperature value with an accuracy of 94.9% at 25 °C... The sensor exhibited consistent responses despite sequential bending, compressing, and twisting.

knowledge_points.content: Neat DPPT-TT films exhibit unstable subthreshold behavior and electrical deterioration under strain due to grain boundaries acting as hole-trapping sites and film cracking, whereas the nanofiber-based blend avoids these issues.
knowledge_points.evidence: These results indicate that the semicrystalline, neat DPPT-TT thin film has numerous grain boundaries that provide hole-trapping sites... In addition, this thin film is easily cracked and disconnected by external stretching, resulting in electrical deterioration.
